item.title: Constitution Day - September 17th
item.description: Date: Thursday, September 17, 2026 10:30 AM - 3:30 PM - Come learn about the US Constitution. Highlights: Constitutional bingo, Visit from Uncle Sam, Voter registration and information, snacks. We will be at The union (15th st lobby) and the Concourse outside Sage Dining hall.

item.title: Study Abroad Information Session
item.description: Study Abroad - It’s Not Too Early to Start Planning for the Experience of a Lifetime! Thinking about studying abroad? Learn from a panel of RPI returnees, international exchange students, and Education Abroad staff. Wednesday, September 16, Bruggeman Room, CBIS, 12:30-1:30. This event is part of the FYE Beyond Blocks series.

item.title: Apply to Join the Student Advisory Council
item.description: As a member of the Council, you’ll represent the student community by sharing thoughts and ideas and providing feedback on current topics and issues being discussed. Meetings will be held every other Friday from 12:00–1:30 p.m., beginning October 2, 2026. Lunch will be served. The deadline to apply is Tuesday, September 15.

item.title: Smoothie Socials
item.description: Wednesday, September 16, 2026 10:00 AM - 11:00 AM - The Office of Alumni Engagement invites all students to join us for RPI Smoothie Socials, your monthly midweek pick-me-up! Enjoy delicious smoothies and snacks, connect with fellow students and select staff members, and get to know the Alumni Engagement team. Each month features a fun theme and a unique giveaway for the first 50 students through the door! September’s theme - Welcome Whirl; Giveaway - RPI blender bottle; Featured flavor -…

item.title: Intellectual Property and Technology Licensing (IPTL) Informational Session
item.description: Date: Wednesday, September 16, 2026 11:00 AM - 12:00 PM - Are you working on groundbreaking research? Are you curious about what happens to your ideas, inventions, research, and software at RPI? Join the Intellectual Property & Technology Licensing (IPTL) team for an informational session on the basics of intellectual property. We’ll cover patents, copyrights, invention disclosures, commercialization, and when you should contact IPTL. Please click on the link for registration and WebEx.

item.title: Help ISSS Create Advising Resources Related to Duration of Status (D/S) Changes
item.description: ISSS is holding two virtual events to gather questions from advisors and academic support staff regarding the Duration of Status (D/S) changes. This will help inform information guides in support of student advising. Please bring questions. Session 1 on Monday, September 28 from 12:00 p.m. - 1:00 p.m., register at: https://tinyurl.com/DS-campuspartner01 Session 2 on Thursday, October 1 from 10:00 a.m. - 11:00 a.m., register at: https://tinyurl.com/DS-campuspartner02

item.title: Pillars of Rensselaer Award — Who has been a pillar of RPI?
item.description: Some people don’t just work at RPI—they help shape it. The Pillars of Rensselaer Award is RPI’s highest and most prestigious honor for staff, recognizing a long-term staff member whose dedication, contributions, and impact have left a lasting mark on the Institute. Who comes to mind?

item.title: Need a Professional Headshot? MMS can help!
item.description:
Multimedia Services provides free professional headshots to faculty and staff; this service is provided once a month. The next available dates are Wednesday September 23, 2026 and Wednesday October 21, 2026! Please use the Photography Request Form to book your appointment now: https://dotcio.rpi.edu/services/audio-video-and-photography/photography-and-portraits
